cover.subtitle: Salt Lake City → Draper
cover.featureSummary: Neighborhood culture, business wins, and the people shaping the Wasatch Front one block at a time.
cover.articleOneText: From coffee culture to creative studios, this issue celebrates the people and places making each valley community feel local and alive.
cover.articleTwoText: Stay tuned for the next round of profiles, businesses, and creative energy from across the mountain communities.

model.name: Ava Sinclair
model.bio: Downtown-based model and content creator, bringing SLC street style to every page.

ads.name: Peak & Pine Coffee Roasters
ads.blurb: Small-batch beans roasted weekly in the Granary District. Try the seasonal cardamom pour-over.

ads.name: Wasatch Wax Candle Co.
ads.blurb: Soy candles poured in small batches, inspired by canyon hikes and mountain air.

ads.name: Iron Door Fitness
ads.blurb: Boutique strength studio with sunrise classes and a members-only sauna.

model.name: Luis sanz
model.bio: West Jordan-raised fashion model and this issue's face for the west jordan.

ads.name: Jordan landing
ads.blurb: Located in the heart of West Jordan, Utah, Jordan Landing is a vibrant shopping destination that brings together the best in retail, dining, and entertainment.

model.name: Jordan Reyes
model.bio: Millcreek native and part-time trail runner, shot on location at Millcreek Canyon.

ads.name: Millcreek Botanical Florals
ads.blurb: Weekly flower subscriptions and same-day arrangements for the whole valley.

model.name: Sienna Cole
model.bio: Sienna splits her time between modeling and coaching youth ski teams at Big Cottonwood.

ads.name: Butterfield Nail Studio
ads.blurb: Custom nail art and gel sets, booked online in under a minute.

model.name: Marcus Bell
model.bio: Marcus is a Sandy-based fitness model and personal trainer, repping the south valley.

ads.name: Sandy Station Barbershop
ads.blurb: Classic cuts and hot towel shaves, walk-ins welcome most weekdays.

model.name: Talia Fenwick
model.bio: Talia is a Draper-raised creative and this month's spotlight face for the south valley.

ads.name: Draper Peak Dental Studio
ads.blurb: Modern, comfort-first dentistry with evening and weekend appointments.

backCover.description: Every issue reaches millios of locals — no more paper 📄 no printing, no mailers, just one link people actually tap. New cities coming soon.
